edits.old: These six criteria are new and test the deployment artefacts only.
edits.new: These eight criteria are new and test the deployment artefacts only.

edits.old: Then no entry carries a personal value or a credential
edits.new:
Then no entry carries a personal value or a credential

  Scenario: AC7 Every business rule of section 8 has a criterion and a test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR10 of section 8
    When the rule table and the coverage line are reviewed against sections 7 and 16
    Then each rule names at least one criterion of section 7 and one test case of section 16
    Then no rule is left without a criterion, and an architecture constraint is tested by a guardrail or boundary test

  Scenario: AC8 A consumed call that fails or does not answer raises an alert and drops no message (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call of the service
    When the call is forced to fail or to not answer in a test namespace
    Then the failure raises the alert of AC5 with MSG-P7-003, the operation and the trace id, and routes to the platform on-call queue
    Then a consumed message follows the retry topic and then its .dlt topic of AC3 and is not dropped
